tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: The stage. Full-bleed page and scene background; the world canvas, imagery and video sit on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Bands and panels one step off the void: footer, chapter index, readout cells, station tiles.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Floating UI: the HUD, ribbon tools, menus, dialogs, drawers, caption cards.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers, inactive progress tracks, chip and tool outlines. Decorative (under 3:1) in every theme but High contrast: never the only edge of a control there.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and display type on void, surface, surface-raised and scrim.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, metadata, eyebrows, readout labels, on void, surface, surface-raised and scrim.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: THE accent: the one thing that matters on this screen (primary action, active chapter, progress fill, one emphasized word). Aliases the skin's hue. Text on void, surface, surface-raised and accent-soft. Below 4.5:1 in thread-day on void/surface (3.93:1): there, 24px+ text, dots and marks only; small text uses ink.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind accent text: selected rows, the current knot's halo, hover wash on list items.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (the primary button label, the current knot numeral).

tokens.name: cue
tokens.usage: Live interaction cues: 'drag', 'hold', 'press', hotspot labels, the tilt bubble, hints. Text on void and the surfaces. Never beside accent in the same element.

tokens.name: on-cue
tokens.usage: Text on a cue fill.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links: alias of accent, underlined. Below 4.5:1 in thread-day on void/surface (3.93:1): there, 24px+ text, dots and marks only; small text uses ink.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors only, always with a word or an icon. Text on void and the surfaces.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid at 2px offset (3px over art). 3:1 or more on every ground in every theme.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay between busy imagery or the world canvas and text: caption cards, hero gradients. ink and ink-muted on scrim are the only sanctioned text-over-media pairings. Over a sun core or a bright horizon, ink-muted on the night scrims falls to about 3:1: keep captions off the light source (SceneCaption places itself away from it) or set the body in ink.

tokens.name: chrome
tokens.usage: Translucent fixed bars (the ribbon) with a blur-chrome backdrop. ink on chrome.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Palette hue. The accent of the mint skin (glasshouse); the mint clearing weather. Text on void and both surfaces. Below 4.5:1 in thread-day on surface (4.3:1): there, 24px+ text, dots and marks only; small text uses ink.

tokens.name: mint-soft
tokens.usage: Soft ground behind mint text (12–16% of the hue over the void). Behind accent text when mint is the skin's accent.

tokens.name: on-mint
tokens.usage: Label color on a mint fill.

tokens.name: frost
tokens.usage: Palette hue. Live interaction cues in every skin (cue aliases it); the night garden weather. Text on void and both surfaces.

tokens.name: frost-soft
tokens.usage: Soft ground behind frost text (12–16% of the hue over the void). Behind accent text when frost is the skin's accent.

tokens.name: on-frost
tokens.usage: Label color on a frost fill.

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: Palette hue. The accent of the peach skin and the peach fall weather. Text on void and both surfaces. Below 4.5:1 in thread-day on surface (4.37:1): there, 24px+ text, dots and marks only; small text uses ink.

tokens.name: peach-soft
tokens.usage: Soft ground behind peach text (12–16% of the hue over the void). Behind accent text when peach is the skin's accent.

tokens.name: on-peach
tokens.usage: Label color on a peach fill.

tokens.name: rain
tokens.usage: Palette hue. The red rain weather only: an emphasized word or the HUD weather name while it rains. Never an error color.

tokens.name: rain-soft
tokens.usage: Soft ground behind rain text (12–16% of the hue over the void). Behind accent text when rain is the skin's accent.

tokens.name: thread
tokens.usage: Palette hue. The accent of the thread skin: knots, beads, numerals. Text on void and both surfaces. Below 4.5:1 in thread-day on void/surface (3.93:1): there, 24px+ text, dots and marks only; small text uses ink.

tokens.name: thread-soft
tokens.usage: Soft ground behind thread text (12–16% of the hue over the void). Behind accent text when thread is the skin's accent.

tokens.name: on-thread
tokens.usage: Label color on a thread fill.

tokens.name: tag-gold
tokens.usage: Categorical tag (first of five: gold, rose, violet, sea, peach). Text and dot on void and the surfaces; the tag fill is this at 12% over the ground.

tokens.name: tag-rose
tokens.usage: Categorical tag. Text and dot on void and the surfaces. Below 4.5:1 in thread-day on surface (4.48:1): there, 24px+ text, dots and marks only; small text uses ink.

tokens.name: tag-violet
tokens.usage: Categorical tag. Text and dot on void and the surfaces.

tokens.name: tag-sea
tokens.usage: Categorical tag. Text and dot on void and the surfaces. Below 4.5:1 in thread-day on surface (4.2:1): there, 24px+ text, dots and marks only; small text uses ink.

tokens.name: tag-peach
tokens.usage: Categorical tag. Text and dot on void and the surfaces. Below 4.5:1 in thread-day on surface (4.11:1): there, 24px+ text, dots and marks only; small text uses ink.

tokens.name: art-void
tokens.usage: The world canvas's own ground: ridge feet, vignette, the eye's pupil side. The skin's night void in every face.

tokens.name: art-ink
tokens.usage: Text riding over the world (df-over-art) in every face: the art is a night scene, so its words keep the night ink.

tokens.name: art-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text over the world (eyebrows over art).

tokens.name: art-accent
tokens.usage: Accent over the world in every face; a weather world sets it to the weather's rim hue.

tokens.name: art-on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on an art-accent fill (a primary button inside a scene).

tokens.name: art-cue
tokens.usage: Hints and interaction cues over the world.

tokens.name: lens-c
tokens.usage: Reality lens misregistration, cyan plate. Decorative only: text shadows, chip offsets, banner dots.

tokens.name: lens-m
tokens.usage: Reality lens misregistration, magenta plate. Decorative only.

tokens.name: lens-y
tokens.usage: Reality lens misregistration, yellow plate. Decorative only.

tokens.usage: Mint clearing: sky, horizon.

tokens.name: wx-night-sky-top

tokens.name: wx-night-sky-low
tokens.usage: Night garden: sky, horizon.

tokens.name: wx-night-sun
tokens.usage: Night garden: the moon.

tokens.name: gh-sky-top
tokens.usage: Glasshouse: sky, top, at the start of the scroll.

tokens.name: gh-sky-top-end
tokens.usage: Glasshouse: sky, top, at the end of the scroll.

tokens.name: gh-sky-low
tokens.usage: Glasshouse: sky, bottom, at the start.

tokens.name: gh-sky-low-end
tokens.usage: Glasshouse: sky, bottom, at the end (frost line).

tokens.name: gh-ridge-1
tokens.usage: Glasshouse: back ridge.

tokens.name: gh-ridge-2
tokens.usage: Glasshouse: middle ridge.

tokens.name: gh-ridge-3

tokens.name: gh-shaft
tokens.usage: Glasshouse: light shafts (additive, 7–10% alpha) and near motes.

tokens.name: gh-glow
tokens.usage: Glasshouse: the cursor-led sun glow (55% at the core).

tokens.name: gh-haze
tokens.usage: Glasshouse: haze bands between ridges (op-haze alpha).

tokens.name: eye-white
tokens.usage: The eye's white (92% alpha).

tokens.name: eye-iris
tokens.usage: The eye's iris and rim stroke.

tokens.name: eye-pupil
tokens.usage: The eye's pupil.

tokens.name: eye-glint
tokens.usage: The eye's catchlight.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per page: the opening scene title. Scale with clamp(64px, 14vw, 160px).

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Chapter titles. clamp(48px, 9vw, 96px).

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Scene statements and pull quotes. clamp(40px, 6vw, 64px).

styles.name: display-italic
styles.usage: The one emphasized word inside a display line, in accent.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Content sections inside a chapter.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Panel and dialog titles, card titles.

styles.name: caption-title
styles.usage: The title line of a SceneCaption over the world.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: A lede that pulls the reader into the next scene.
styles.usage: Narrative paragraphs beside or under a scene; max 34em. Fluid: clamp(18px, 2vw, 21px), line height 1.5.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Body copy for longer reading passages.
styles.usage: Default reading text; max 64ch.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Pressure here is two hundred times the surface.
styles.usage: SceneCaption body, FoundCard facts, drawer notes. ink-muted on scrim or surface-raised.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Buttons, menu items, small UI copy.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase chapter markers, labels above titles, caption labels.

styles.name: label-mono
styles.usage: Uppercase tool labels, jump links, chip text, the mono button.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Numeric readouts: progress, coordinates, timestamps. Use tabular-nums.

styles.name: hint
styles.sample: Three spores are hiding in the haze. 0 found.
styles.usage: The one-line interaction hint under a lede, set in cue.

styles.name: thread-hero
styles.usage: Thread skin only: the hero title. clamp(76px, 15vw, 196px).

styles.name: thread-title
styles.usage: Thread skin: section heads. clamp(40px, 6vw, 76px); one word in italic thread.

styles.name: thread-station
styles.usage: Thread skin: Station titles. clamp(30px, 3.4vw, 46px).

styles.name: thread-numeral
styles.usage: Thread skin: station numbers and version numerals, in thread. clamp(40px, 4vw, 56px).

styles.name: thread-body
styles.sample: Every chapter ends at a door.
styles.usage: Thread skin: reading text. clamp(17px, 0.35vw + 15.5px, 19px).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: eyebrow to title.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding (vertical); gaps inside a scene text block.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter; card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Control padding (horizontal); paragraph gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter; HUD inset.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between title block and body.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between content groups inside a scene.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a chapter; a beat's top padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between chapters (static); pinned scenes use viewport units instead.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Full-bleed media, scenes and the world canvas. Imagery that fills the frame is never rounded.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, tags, small cards.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Tiles, list rows, readout cells, drawer items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Floating panels: caption cards, menus, dialogs, the FoundCard.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, tools, chips, the HUD and progress tracks.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating panels over scenes: the HUD, menus, the FoundCard. High contrast swaps the shadow for a 3:1 outline.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and the current knot, at night only; day faces have no glow.

tokens.name: shadow-drawer
tokens.usage: The Drawer's leading edge.

tokens.name: shadow-banner
tokens.usage: Bottom banners: the LensBanner, the ReelHud.

tokens.name: shadow-type-display
tokens.usage: text-shadow for display type riding over the world canvas (never over flat grounds). Night values in both faces: the art is a night scene.

tokens.name: shadow-type-lede
tokens.usage: text-shadow for ledes and hints riding over the world canvas.

tokens.name: z-scene
tokens.usage: The world canvas, video and pinned media layers.

tokens.name: z-content
tokens.usage: Scene text riding over the world.

tokens.name: z-hotspot
tokens.usage: Hotspot buttons laid over art (above text so they stay pressable).

tokens.name: z-caption
tokens.usage: The live SceneCaption that follows a hotspot.

tokens.name: z-lens
tokens.usage: The LensBanner.

tokens.name: z-chrome
tokens.usage: The Ribbon and other fixed top chrome.

tokens.name: z-drawer
tokens.usage: The Drawer and its veil.

tokens.name: z-hud
tokens.usage: Progress, HUD chips, the sound toggle, the TiltChip, the ReelHud.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the Loader, the FoundCard.

tokens.name: z-cursor
tokens.usage: The CursorRing follower.

tokens.name: depth-pointer-back
tokens.usage: Back plane (far ridge) shift across the full pointer travel; the plane moves with the pointer, never against it.

tokens.name: depth-pointer-mid
tokens.usage: Middle plane shift across the full pointer travel.

tokens.name: depth-pointer-front
tokens.usage: Front plane shift across the full pointer travel.

tokens.name: depth-sink-back
tokens.usage: How far the back plane sinks over the whole scroll: scrolling is the camera descending.

tokens.name: depth-sink-mid
tokens.usage: Middle plane sink over the whole scroll.

tokens.name: depth-sink-front
tokens.usage: Front plane sink over the whole scroll.

tokens.name: depth-scroll-max
tokens.usage: Ceiling for scroll parallax on any backdrop: never faster than 0.3 times the scroll.

tokens.name: depth-follow
tokens.usage: Per-frame follow factor for pointer parallax at 60 fps (the planes ease after the pointer).

tokens.name: depth-tilt-gain
tokens.usage: Phone tilt (sine of the angle) to pointer-equivalent parallax, clamped to the full travel.

tokens.name: blur-backdrop
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur under SceneCaption, FoundCard and dialogs; falls back to the solid scrim.

tokens.name: blur-chrome
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur under the Ribbon (with saturate 1.2).

tokens.name: blur-dof-1
tokens.usage: Depth of field: a plane one step from the focus plane.

tokens.name: blur-dof-2
tokens.usage: Depth of field: two steps from focus.

tokens.name: blur-dof-3
tokens.usage: Depth of field: three steps from focus, or everything behind an open dialog.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, a glow arriving.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: UI enter and exit; SceneCaption fade-and-rise.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Text reveals; an accent following the weather.

tokens.name: dur-scene
tokens.usage: Scene crossfades and weather blends.

tokens.name: dur-rise
tokens.usage: The hero title rising on load.

tokens.name: dur-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between staggered lines or items.

tokens.name: dur-wink-open
tokens.usage: The eye: how long it stays open between winks.

tokens.name: dur-wink-closed
tokens.usage: The eye: how long a wink keeps it shut.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Reveals, entrances, hovers: everything that arrives.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Camera moves and scene transitions.

tokens.name: ease-scrub
tokens.usage: Anything tied to scroll position: progress fills, scrubbed camera and parallax. Scroll is already the easing.

tokens.name: bp-medium
tokens.usage: Medium window and up: HUD chips appear, gutters grow to space-6, scene text can sit to one side.

tokens.name: bp-expanded
tokens.usage: Expanded: Station asides take their own column; the ribbon shows labels.

tokens.name: bp-wide
tokens.usage: Wide: content stops growing at size-container; the world keeps filling the window.

tokens.name: size-target
tokens.usage: Minimum target for anything pressable (tools are 34px tall with 44px of hit area).

tokens.name: size-hotspot
tokens.usage: A Hotspot's hit area laid over art.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Button height (12px + 20px + 12px).

tokens.name: size-tool
tokens.usage: Tool height (ribbon and HUD tools).

tokens.name: size-icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside tools and chips.

tokens.name: size-icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons beside body text and in buttons.

tokens.name: size-icon-lg
tokens.usage: Standalone icons; the icon grid.

tokens.name: size-measure-body
tokens.usage: Max line length for body copy.

tokens.name: size-measure-lede
tokens.usage: Max width for a scene text block and its lede.

tokens.name: size-measure-narrow
tokens.usage: A narrow scene block for short statements.

tokens.name: size-caption
tokens.usage: Max width of a SceneCaption.

tokens.name: size-drawer
tokens.usage: Drawer width (never wider than the window).

tokens.name: size-container
tokens.usage: Max width of non-scene content (sections, ribbon).

tokens.name: size-track
tokens.usage: Max width of the ScrollProgress track (clamp(80px, 18vw, 160px)).

tokens.name: op-haze
tokens.usage: Peak alpha of a haze band between ridges.

tokens.name: op-shaft
tokens.usage: Base alpha of a light shaft (additive).

tokens.name: op-vignette
tokens.usage: Vignette alpha at the corners (void).

tokens.name: op-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls (with a reason nearby; disabled text is exempt from contrast).

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: Hairlines, tool and chip outlines, the ribbon's edge.

tokens.name: border-glyph
tokens.usage: Chip status glyphs and drawn icon strokes at 24px (the icon grid uses 1.5).

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring width.

tokens.name: border-focus-offset
tokens.usage: Focus ring offset on flat grounds.

tokens.name: border-focus-offset-art
tokens.usage: Focus ring offset over the world canvas.

tokens.name: scene-beat
tokens.usage: One beat: a scene section is at least this tall; a pinned sequence is a whole number of beats.

tokens.name: scene-gutter
tokens.usage: Inline padding of a beat (space-4 on phones to space-6).

tokens.name: scene-pad-top
tokens.usage: Top padding of a top-anchored beat.

tokens.name: scene-pad-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom padding of a bottom-anchored beat: room for the HUD.

tokens.name: scene-hero
tokens.usage: Height of an image hero.

tokens.name: scene-section
tokens.usage: Block padding of a static section between scenes.
